scope: Show durable model-call activity during generation, without modifying workflow stages or restarting the user run
observed_problem: The running single-author harness remained on coordinator stage plan at progress 0; call receipts existed in storage but were absent from the monitor.
transport: HTTP polling every 1.5 seconds, no WebSocket required
changes: Current operation, elapsed call time and lease-based worker contact
Chronological call history, bounded to the latest 100 receipts
Indeterminate progress until completion; stale-fence calls never displayed as active
No response bodies, response keys or worker lease secrets in activity payload

python_suite.skips: 7 PostgreSQL-only cases and 15 opt-in Docker/browser cases

checks.browser: Authenticated fresh project page displays all four completed calls and their durations. Existing user play session was left intact.
checks.deployment: Studio gracefully reloaded; generator and validator not restarted

limitations: The observed game was generated by the user before this UI patch; no additional paid inference was started.
Live pending-call display is covered by deterministic server/frontend tests; browser verification used the completed real run.
Automatic game checks do not establish genre depth, balance or target WebView compatibility.
